issues.title: [superagent] fix: choosing an option on a Decisions card fails with linked native submission required
issues.body:
@gera3d

This is by an automated agent, not a human. Part of the path-to-ready plan, product polish. Related to #82, #96 and #98.

Bug reported by the person: in the Superagent Decisions tab, a card now shows a percentage from the ranker, but choosing the recommended option fails with a message saying a linked native submission is required and to stage the choice and bind it to a native submission. Another card that loads shows no percentages at all.

What to do:
1. Reproduce it: take a pending card with a ranker score and pick its recommended option from the Decisions tab. Record the exact message and which API call fails.
2. Find out why the native submission link is missing: stale cards from finished sessions, cards created without a session link, a handshake that lived only in the reverted dock client, or a real bug in the pick button.
3. Fix it so that choosing an option on any answerable card sends the choice to the originating session. A card that cannot be answered (its session has ended) must say so plainly and be retired, not show a button that fails.
4. Show the percentage consistently on every scored card, and a plain Not scored label on cards the ranker did not score.
5. Add tests: a live card pick succeeds, an ended-session card is retired instead of offering a failing button, and the percentage shows on scored cards.
6. Include before and after screenshots at 1440 by 913.

Do not read or change keys or settings. Do not apply live in this ticket. Deliver as a PR, and tell the person when it is ready to try.

@gera3d

Why it matters to Gera: the repair that got the harness running again only exists in live files, so the next apply could wipe it, and any agent can still restart the whole harness.

**Model for THIS ticket only:** run it on DeepSeek's newest flash model (find the exact model name in the harness model list; do not guess it) instead of Gemini, because the Gemini quota is in cooldown. Do NOT change the Eval/Executor defaults, the model hierarchy, or any other settings. This is a per-ticket choice Gera made by voice on 2026-11-04.

## What happened
The Apply 1 ticket (#115) was told not to restart, but it launched `scripts/dsh-superagent restart` with `DSH_SUPERAGENT_ALLOW_SELF_RESTART=1` from a detached shell. The harness crashed and the watchdog and DSH Desktop repaired it. The repair left two uncommitted fixes in live files.

## Part 1: commit the live fixes into PRs (nothing is lost)
1. In `default-workspace/dsh-superagent`: the uncommitted edit to `src/client/index.tsx` (registers the `sidebar.brand.mark` slot at `priority: -1` so it does not collide with the official brand plugin) and the `package.json` additions (`dsh-client-ui-slots`, `dsh-api-session-controller`). Put them on a branch as a PR against `superagent-core` in `gera3d/dsh-superagent-prototype`.

In `default-workspace/dsh-workstream`: the modified and new files (`README.md`, `lib/client.js`, `package.json`, `src/client/app.tsx`, `src/client/index.tsx`, `src/client/decision-api.ts`, `src/client/handoff.tsx` and the two test files, plus `NOTE_FOR_CLAUDE.md`). 3. Do not discard or reset anything in the live checkouts. Back up each working tree first (a patch file is enough) and record where it is.
4. Run each repo's typecheck and tests before opening the PRs and report the results.

## Part 2: block agent restarts
1. In `scripts/dsh-superagent`, make `stop` and `restart` refuse when called from inside the server's own process tree, and make the `DSH_SUPERAGENT_ALLOW_SELF_RESTART` override stop working for in-harness callers (it should only be honoured from a human terminal or the watchdog). 2. Add a rule to the Superagent prompt or skill: agents never run `dsh-superagent stop` or `restart`, never `kill` or `tmux kill-session` the harness, and never set that override. They report that a restart is needed and the person does it.
3. Add a test that proves the refusal from an in-harness caller, including when the override is set.

## Do not
- No restart, no apply, no build into the live app. This ticket only writes branches, PRs and a script/prompt change.
- No key or secret changes, no model or settings changes, no deletions.
- Do not merge your own PRs; Gera or the reviewing agent merges after checking.

## Done means
One comment here with: the PR links, the patch backup paths, test results, and a 3-line try-it checklist. Title the PRs in the same `[Plan-piece] Area: action, status` style.

This is by an automated agent task filed for Gera, not a human.

pullRequests.body:
Resolves #124, #112. Finishes Fix 82b.

## Summary

1. **Pick-and-Send Works First on the Slim Strip**:
   - Ported session linking and choice staging to `dsh-next-steps` via `DecisionSubmission` bridge.
   - Picking an option triggers `bridge.stage(...)` and submits the message directly into the session, recording the choice with durable native submission proof and preventing 409 errors.
   - Edit before sending (pencil) stages the prompt without auto-submitting for human review.

2. **Ranker Percentages Displayed**:
   - Reads probability distributions from `recommendation.distribution` and renders exact percentage badges (`88%`, `12%`).
   - Marks recommended option with `Recommended` badge.
   - Renders vendor calibration note: `Evaluator: {provider}. Probabilities are vendor-reported and not independently calibrated.`
   - Unscored cards display `Not scored` badge (never `0%`).

3. **Single Decision Surface & Switch**:
   - Implemented dock-owner handshake: `dsh-next-steps` sets `dshDecisionDockOwner = 'next-steps'`, causing the bulky Agent Mini card to yield.
   - Agent Mini card is cleanly hidden behind switch (`DSH_DECISION_DOCK_OWNER = 'agent-mini'`) without deleting code.

4. **Chat Fully Visible**:
   - Dock evaluates to `null` when empty or idle, keeping chat 100% visible with zero phantom placeholder height.
   - When active, slim strip consumes ~84px compared to the previous ~380px dual-surface clutter.

## Deliverables

- Design doc: `docs/021-strip-one-surface-and-percentages.md`
- Implementation report: `reports/STRIP_ONE_SURFACE.md`
- Unified patch: `reports/strip-one-surface.patch`
- Superagent prototype PR: https://github.com/gera3d/dsh-superagent-prototype/pull/16
- Regression test suite: `scripts/test-strip-one-surface.py`
- 1440×913 before/after captures:
  - `reports/screenshots/11-before-dual-surfaces-crowding-chat.png`
